PREFACE 

As in previous directories, alumni are listed herein by present geographical location, by classes, and alphabetically. Business addresses have been used in preference to residence addresses although in several instances, both are shown.

All those who have successfully completed two or more years of undergraduate study at the University of Minnesota Law School are listed so far as our information goes. In accordance with provisions of the Articles of 

Incorporation and By-Laws of the Law Alumni Association as revised April 

19, 1949, listings include not only those members who received the LL.B. with or without the B.S.L., but also those members who qualified only for the 

B.S.L. and for the LL.M. as well as the non-alumni entitled to honorary membership.

Much effort has been made to contact all living alumni and to verify information concerning those who have passed on. But it is too much to hope that our information is entirely complete and accurate. 

We have received many letters from alumni concerning the whereabouts of those in our "Address Unknown” file and wish to acknowledge gratefully the assistance so rendered. One clue has led to another so that several records are still not completely checked. 

This directory was prepared by Geraldine Shephard with assistance from the Law School staff under the supervision of the Association's treasurer, Professor Stanley V. Kinyon. We sincerely acknowledge and appreciate the many hours of conscientious effort which this staff has devoted to the compilation and verification of data herein. Acknowledgment should also be made of the invaluable records made over the years by Miss Millicent Purdy who prepared several previous editions of the directory.
